Image prompt:
Flat top-down scan of a tall narrow sheet of pale cream washi paper with visible fibres. On it, a loose sumi ink brush drawing of a small moss garden seen from above: a winding thin stream line from top to bottom, a few oval stepping stones, a round water basin, and soft grey ink washes marking areas of moss. Restrained, elegant, with lots of empty paper. Monochrome ink only. No writing, no characters, no red seals, no signature. Tall portrait 1:3.
